FAQ

What is SniffShift?

SniffShift is a conceptual delayed-access enrichment station for dogs. It uses a proposed three-stage mechanism—sniff, shift, wait—to present a puzzle-feeding concept rather than instant treat access.

How does the three-stage process work?

Proposed: first, your dog sniffs the scent chamber to locate food. Second, they shift internal sliders with their paws and nose to align the release path. Third, they wait for the timed gate to open, which delays access. Actual performance has not been verified.

Is SniffShift suitable for all dog sizes?

SniffShift comes in Small, Medium, and Large sizes as a prototype concept. The right size depends on your dog's breed, snout length, and paw size. Supervise initial use to ensure your dog can engage with the mechanism.

How do I clean SniffShift?

Hand wash only with warm, soapy water. Do not place in the dishwasher or submerge in water. Dry thoroughly before reuse.

Is SniffShift a finished product?

No. SniffShift is an early-stage prototype. The images are conceptual representations, and specifications may change before final production. Some dogs may not engage with the delayed-access mechanism.

Does SniffShift slow down fast eaters?

The delayed-access design is proposed to extend feeding time by requiring your dog to work through three stages before food is released. Results vary by dog—some may learn quickly, others may need more time or may not engage at all. This has not been verified.
